data.sub: Kerala ke 63 saal ke shakhs ne video dekh paise gawaye
data.asar: Online trading schemes se bachein aur savdhan rahein
data.caption:
Deepfake aur AI ke zariye fraud ka hairan karne wala mamla samne aaya hai! 🚨

📌 Kerala ke ek 63 saal ke shakhs se ₹1.42 crore thage gaye
📌 Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ka fake video banaya gaya tha
📌 Video mein trading ke zariye mote munafey ka jhootha lalach diya gaya tha

Kisi bhi aisi scheme par bharosa na karein. Apne family groups aur doston ko share karke alert karein!
